run_id_rule: must be regenerated with `date -u +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S` at execution time; never reuse old RUN_ID
before_future_execution_runner_must: check send hard-disable still exists (grep raise ExecutionSendDisabledInImplementationBuildStage)
re-read chain live state (chain_id / slot0 / NPM code / pool code)
recompute dynamic tick range (no cached snapshot)
re-input approval phrase manually (even if same string)
live USDC.allowance check (skip if sufficient; ApproveExact otherwise)
operator confirms 8 items in risk acceptance packet
hard_disable_release_rules_future_only: must be a dedicated commit (no mixed changes)
commit message must start with 'unseal:' + detailed rationale
second reviewer / second audit pipeline must approve
released executor must re-pass implementation + final review stages
safe_dry_run_safety_note: this command is read-only (eth_chainId + eth_call slot0 only) in every stage; but this stage does NOT actively run it because prior review stage already validated independently
